summary: Wrote an 8-phase, 13-hour implementation plan for the touched-path verify entry point and the classified unmapped fallback. Phases are ordered so the externally-consumed contracts land first: the single .claude-extensions.json verification_scope declaration key (with project_gates/closing_gate field names reserved for the adjacent records), then the resolver interface whose default backend is suite_selection_select unchanged, then the classified fallback and owed record, the verify-touched.sh entry point, the coverage report, the batch-gate discharge, the standards/directive rewrite, and a closing suite plus redeploy. Six design decisions are settled with rejected alternatives recorded, including sentinel-survives-as-opt-in, union composition, and warn-not-fail coverage.

artifacts.summary: 8-phase plan covering all six deliverables, with measured premise re-validation and six settled design decisions.
